summary: The real dev chain ran end-to-end on a fresh anvil: 438/438 receipts succeeded, every require passed, and the on-chain smoke harvest and a UI-path harvest both succeeded. The artifacts are deterministic (only timestamps differ), so story-116's 'no existing address moved' claim is confirmed. The delta introduced no new bug, side-effect or cluster finding. One faithfulness recurrence is submitted, and it reuses an existing fingerprint triple so it reconciles to ledger da94d1ba03fd.

findings.title: dev-local.sh's API-port pre-flight (9762281) and two other delta commits touching dev's closure shipped with no story, so the API-port gate has no acceptance criteria to be graded against
findings.reconcilesTo: da94d1ba03fd (same contract/function/rootCauseClass, so the fingerprint reconciles; this is a recurrence with new instances, not a new entry)
findings.description: Commit 9762281 'anvil deployment and port blocking check' (2026-10-18) adds 47 lines to dev-local.sh: the API_PORT pre-flight with ss/lsof//dev/tcp listener discovery and pid/cwd reporting. It also regenerates the tracked broadcast and addresses.ts. It carries no [story-NNN] tag, and no story under ~/code/product-owner/stories/phStaging2 covers it. story-081, which created dev-local.sh, specifies only the :8545 ownership and freshness gates. The same holds for package.json delta commits 18b5ac6 'Accounting layer' and 58c3b4f 'sepolia deploy', which also touches script/helpers/UniswapHelperLocalStack.sol. Separately, the start:anvil block-time flip from 2 to 5 (6c9416d, 2026-09-14, outside this delta) is untagged, and it is what made dev-local.sh's 'byte-identical' comment false.
findings.evidence: `git log --oneline dfbf2f9..d0060cb -- dev-local.sh` -> only `9762281 anvil deployment and port blocking check`. closure-manifest.delta.files[dev-local.sh].stories == [] and package.json.untaggedCommits == [18b5ac6, 58c3b4f]. The behaviour itself works empirically: re-running ./dev-local.sh against the live stack exited 1 with 'Error: port 3001 is already in use ... kill 35345' and deleted nothing.
findings.severityRationale: Law 2 provenance gap only. The gate behaves correctly and fails safe, and no user-facing state is wrong. It is kept at the existing entry's severity so it folds into da94d1ba03fd rather than spawning a sibling.
findings.impact: The pre-flight has no acceptance criteria, so a future change to it (for example dropping the ss/lsof fallback) cannot be graded, and the same goes for the other two untagged commits.
findings.recommendation: Retro-file a short story (or amend story 081 with an addendum) that states the API-port gate's acceptance criteria: refuse when API_PORT has any listener on any interface, before clean:local, printing the pid and cwd. Tag future dev-local.sh / package.json commits with their story. Append 9762281, 18b5ac6 and 58c3b4f to da94d1ba03fd's note rather than opening a new entry.
